summary: Iteration 9 — Weddly multi-fix verification. Backend (5/5 pytest passed) validated the removed 'other wedding' restriction on /api/wedding/activate, most-recent membership resolution in /api/auth/me, partner-2 join flow, third-user 409, and /api/ai/chat acceptance of the new `lang` field.
